html:
The flight of the Nagorno Karabakh Armenians took place in late September 2023, when more than 100,000 Armenians, almost the whole population of the region, left for Armenia within about a week.

It followed a nine month blockade of the only road to Armenia, the Lachin corridor, and a one day Azerbaijani offensive on 19 September that forced the local Armenian authorities to disarm and dissolve their republic. Russian peacekeepers did not intervene. A fuel depot explosion on the road killed more than 200 people. The exodus ended an Armenian presence in Karabakh that went back many centuries, with its monasteries and villages. Azerbaijan took full control of the land fought over since the first war.
sum: The flight of the Nagorno Karabakh Armenians took place in late September 2023, when more than 100,000 Armenians, almost the whole population of the region, left for Armenia within about a week.
